latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Kling AI Video skill.
- Enables AI-generated video creation from text prompts or uploaded images/videos.
- Supports major formats (JPG, PNG, MP4, MOV) up to 200MB per file.
- Streamlined cloud-based workflow: upload, describe the animation, receive downloadable 1080p MP4 in minutes.
- Includes video editing features (aspect ratio, text overlays, audio tracks) via natural language commands.
- Automatically manages authentication, session creation, and error handling for a smooth user experience.
